about: Native Wolverine data patches over Schaefer's own attack frame records (plan section 4.2). Addresses are arcade ROM addresses; value is the replacement. Originals are read from the ROM at build time and stay in the generated include (never committed). A record is duration(2) flags(2) sprite pointer(4) hurt box, attack box, ...; the first word is the duration in ticks. Native taps: script A (stages 1 and 2, 15 ticks: 1 + 2 + 6 + 5 + 1) and script B (stage 3, heavy punch, 15 ticks: 1 + 2 + 6 + 3 + 2 + 1).

patches.name: tapA_startup
patches.note: script A startup 2 -> 1: startup 2 ticks with the entry tick
